r.name: Kennet and Avon Canal Trail
r.description: Rivers linked by a canal. The name refers to the entire navigable length. From Bristol the way is the Avon. The canal is from Bath to Newbury. From there to Reading the way is the Kennet. 53 locks to Summit Pound (150 m asl) and 54 down to Reading.

r.name: Chineham to Town Centre Accessibility Improvements
King Alfred's Way
r.description: King Alfreds Way is 350km (220 miles) off road route designed to be ridden clockwise. It starts & ends in Winchester. It is suitable for gravel or cross-country bikes.

r.name: Wetlands Walk
r.description: Temporarily closed (frequent flooding, repairs due in Spring 2026)

r.name: Morgaston Woods Green Route, The Vyne
r.description: This half-mile walk through Morgaston Woods, shorter than the longer yellow route, passes the bird hide and ever-changing colours of the trees along the way. Well-maintained woodland paths. Can get muddy when wet. Tree roots cross some paths.

r.name: Morgaston Woods Yellow Route, The Vyne
r.description: This 1-mile walk will take you deeper into Morgaston Woods than the shorter, green route, while still forming a neat loop for you to go on and see other things afterwards. Dogs are welcome.

r.name: Woodland Walk at The Vyne
r.description: Enjoy this relaxing circular stroll through the trees all year round at The Vyne. Look out for the remains of a medieval fish pond and the remnants of a storage site built for use during the Second World War. Dogs on leads are welconme.

r.name: Woodland Walk, Basildon Park
r.description: This route goes through the woodland and across our landscape parkland. Suitable for all terrain pushchairs. Potential for livestock on route.

r.name: Hidden Valley, Basildon Park
r.description: A route throught our secluded valley, down the carriage drive and up the old drive to the mansion. Potential for livestock on route.

r.name: Boundary Walk, Basildon Park
r.description: Around the boundary of the parkland, this route includes the oldest trees at the properties. Suitable for all terrain pushchairs. Potential for livestock on route.
